implementedChanges.implementation: Updated Rogita passives: Gotchya!, The Monkey King, Instant Teleportation

implementedChanges.prompt: Add Bug Reports and Suggestions links

implementedChanges.prompt: Create patch notes system
implementedChanges.implementation: Added scrollable patch notes panel in center of menu with auto-versioning

implementedChanges.prompt: Auto-patch system created
implementedChanges.implementation: Added automatic patch notes tracking with revert detection

implementedChanges.prompt: Create two-tier dev mode with API key protection
implementedChanges.implementation: Added Advanced Dev Mode requiring API key for character icon, rarity, and color editing

implementedChanges.prompt: Add shareable tierlist feature
implementedChanges.implementation: Added Create Shareable Tierlist button with encoded URL generation, includes notes and traits

implementedChanges.prompt: Change CuChulainn to Mythic rarity
implementedChanges.implementation: Updated CuChulainn from Exclusive to Mythic rarity

implementedChanges.prompt: Update multiple character rarities
implementedChanges.implementation: Changed Saber, Sosuke, Kempache, LordFriezo, Noruto to Mythic; Changed Pweeny to Exclusive

implementedChanges.prompt: Add Vanguard Familiar passives feature
implementedChanges.implementation: Added Familiar tab to unit modal showing familiar abilities for 6 units (Gujo, Gilgamesh, Sukono, Valentine, Tengon, Obita). Created familiarPassives.js with familiar data. Tab includes familiar icon and ability descriptions.

implementedChanges.prompt: Update familiar passives with accurate wiki data
implementedChanges.implementation: Replaced familiar passives with accurate data from Anime Vanguards Wiki for all 6 familiars (Gujo's Glasses, Sukono's Finger, Tengon's Smokebomb, Key of Babylon, Secluded Kunai, American Flag)

implementedChanges.prompt: Add familiar icons to familiar tab
implementedChanges.implementation: Updated familiar icon paths to use correct folder (Images/Units/Familiar icons/) for both tab button and header display

implementedChanges.prompt: Update familiar icons and backgrounds
implementedChanges.implementation: Changed familiar icon paths to use familiar names (e.g., 'American Flag.webp' instead of 'ValentineFamiliar.webp'). Added unit rarity background gradients to familiar icon display matching the unit's rarity style

implementedChanges.prompt: Fix familiar icon URL encoding
implementedChanges.implementation: Added proper URL encoding (encodeURIComponent) to handle special characters in familiar icon filenames (apostrophes and spaces)

implementedChanges.prompt: Simplify familiar icon display with gradient overlay
implementedChanges.implementation: Replaced image loading with sparkle emoji overlay on unit's rarity gradient background. Changed tab label from 'Familiar' to show actual familiar name (e.g., 'American Flag', 'Gujo's Glasses')

implementedChanges.prompt: Add familiar icon images overlaid on gradient backgrounds
implementedChanges.implementation: Added familiar icon images from Units/Familiar icons/ folder overlaid on unit rarity gradient backgrounds in both tab button and header display

implementedChanges.prompt: Add fallback display for familiar icons
implementedChanges.implementation: Added sparkle emoji fallback when familiar icon images fail to load (images not yet committed to GitHub). Icons will show image if available, otherwise display sparkle emoji on gradient background

implementedChanges.prompt: Fix React hooks violation in familiar tab
implementedChanges.implementation: Removed useState hook from IIFE that was breaking React's rules of hooks. Now uses simple CSS display toggle for fallback emoji

implementedChanges.prompt: Remove sparkle emoji fallback from familiar icons
implementedChanges.implementation: Removed sparkle emoji fallback now that familiar icon images are properly committed to GitHub and loading correctly

implementedChanges.prompt: Remove sparkle emoji fallback from familiar icons
implementedChanges.implementation: Removed sparkle emoji fallback now that familiar icon images are properly committed to GitHub and loading correctly

implementedChanges.prompt: Add dynamic background cycling on tab changes
implementedChanges.implementation: Background now randomly cycles through all images in Images/backgrounds/bgs/ folder when switching between menu/tierlist/unitlist views. Each view change picks a random background from the 7 available images

implementedChanges.prompt: Add dynamic themed UI for each background
implementedChanges.implementation: Created 7 unique color themes that automatically apply when backgrounds change. Each theme includes custom colors for glass effects, overlays, and accents that complement the background image (Blue, Purple, Pink, Green, Orange, Cyan, Red themes)

implementedChanges.prompt: Update patch notes and title theming
implementedChanges.implementation: Patch notes no longer show file/folder references. Title text now dynamically changes color and glow to match the current background theme

implementedChanges.prompt: Add guide modal and PDF export with watermark
implementedChanges.implementation: Added comprehensive guide modal with sections for getting started, dev mode, exporting, and tips. Implemented PDF export functionality using jspdf and html2canvas libraries. Created watermark image overlay for professional PDF exports. Added Download PDF button next to shareable link button.

implementedChanges.prompt: Enhanced gradient UI effects
implementedChanges.implementation: Improved glass morphism effects with multi-color gradients, added pseudo-element shine overlays on glass elements, enhanced button hover effects with gradient sweep animations, added themed scrollbar styling with gradients, increased blur and saturation for more depth, added scale transforms on hover for better feedback

implementedChanges.prompt: Enhanced PDF export quality and styling
implementedChanges.implementation: Increased canvas scale to 3x for higher quality, added padding and gradient background to PDF, added subtle border styling, moved watermark to top-left with semi-transparent rounded background, increased watermark opacity to 85%, improved loading indicator with better messaging, added success notification with filename, better PDF compression settings, improved filename format with date

implementedChanges.prompt: Fix PDF export character image rendering
implementedChanges.implementation: Increased imageTimeout to 15000ms for proper image loading, disabled foreignObjectRendering for better image compatibility, added ignoreElements filter to exclude fixed overlays, added timeout fallback for watermark loading to prevent hanging

implementedChanges.prompt: Fix PDF character images with preloading
implementedChanges.implementation: Preload all character images and convert to data URLs before PDF capture to avoid CORS issues, disabled useCORS since images are now data URLs, added progress indicators for image preparation and capture stages, improved error handling for individual image conversions

implementedChanges.prompt: Fix PDF image rendering and stretch watermark
implementedChanges.implementation: Changed image loading approach to wait for images to complete loading naturally instead of converting to data URLs, enabled useCORS and logging for debugging, increased watermark size from 18% to 25% width for better visibility, reduced scale to 2.5x to improve rendering performance while maintaining quality

implementedChanges.prompt: Add all unit character images
implementedChanges.implementation: Committed 137 unit character images to GitHub repository so they can be properly loaded from raw URLs during PDF export and normal usage

implementedChanges.prompt: Fix unit and familiar image loading throughout application
implementedChanges.implementation: Created getCharacterImageUrl function to properly load unit images from GitHub raw URLs instead of relying only on custom uploads, created getFamiliarIconUrl function to map familiar names to icon filenames, updated CharacterCard to use new image functions, fixed modal image display to use GitHub URLs, fixed all familiar icon references in modal tabs, images now properly load from committed GitHub files

implementedChanges.prompt: Add jpg fallback and enhance unit borders
implementedChanges.implementation: Added jpg format fallback for unit images when webp fails to load, implemented gradient-matching borders using border-image from rarity backgrounds, increased border thickness to 3px, enhanced shadow effects with layered box-shadows and inset shadows for depth, borders now use the same gradient as the unit's rarity background making them stand out more

implementedChanges.prompt: Add distinctive Vanguard unit styling
implementedChanges.implementation: Vanguard units now have 4px borders (vs 3px for others), cyan pulsing glow effect with 3 layers of shadows (25px, 50px, 75px), animated pulsing border that grows from 4px to 5px, smooth 2-second pulse animation cycle, distinct cyan/teal glow makes Vanguard units immediately recognizable and stand out from other rarities

implementedChanges.prompt: Add animated patterns and effects for all rarities
implementedChanges.implementation: Vanguard: rotating outer ring with gradient animation plus animated border that shifts colors, Mythic: shimmer effect that sweeps across the card with cyan glow, Exclusive: pulsing radial glow that scales and fades in red tones, all animations run on smooth infinite loops (2-3 seconds), each rarity now has unique visual identity with animated borders and particle effects

implementedChanges.prompt: Add unique animated effects for each Vanguard unit
implementedChanges.implementation: Vsjw: shadowy purple pulses with dark wave sweeping across, Divalo: animated scythe slash effect cutting across border in red tones, Iscanur: flickering flames rising from bottom with orange glow, Koguro: ice-fire gradient that shifts between blue and orange, Rogita: yellow-gold Super Saiyan aura with rapid flickering, BrolziSuper: green Super Saiyan aura with rapid flickering, removed generic Vanguard animations, each unit now has character-specific themed border effects

implementedChanges.prompt: Enhance Divalo scythe slash effect
implementedChanges.implementation: Added diagonal slash animation that sweeps across border every 4 seconds, slash appears for brief moment (5-30% of cycle) then disappears, bright red-white gradient creates sharp blade effect, added pulsing red glow background, enhanced drop shadows for glowing slash trail, slash now more visible and impactful with timed appearance

implementedChanges.prompt: Enhance Divalo scythe slash effect
implementedChanges.implementation: Added diagonal slash animation that sweeps across border every 4 seconds, slash appears for brief moment (5-30% of cycle) then disappears, bright red-white gradient creates sharp blade effect, added pulsing red glow background, enhanced drop shadows for glowing slash trail, slash now more visible and impactful with timed appearance

implementedChanges.prompt: Add videoplayback.mp4 to main menu top-right with looping audio
implementedChanges.implementation: Added video player element in top-right corner of main menu with themed border and hover effects. Added separate audio element that loops continuously across all menu views. Video is muted for autoplay compliance while audio plays separately.

implementedChanges.prompt: Fix video and audio playback
implementedChanges.implementation: Added audio control button, error handlers, playsInline attribute, wrapped video in container div, added mute/unmute toggle, improved z-index positioning

implementedChanges.prompt: Fix PDF export black boxes issue
implementedChanges.implementation: Added crossOrigin attribute to all character and familiar images, improved image preloading with proper CORS handling, increased imageTimeout to 15s, forced reload of images with crossOrigin before capture, added onclone callback to ensure cloned images have crossOrigin set

implementedChanges.prompt: Fix PDF export black boxes issue
implementedChanges.implementation: Added crossOrigin attribute to all character and familiar images, improved image preloading with proper CORS handling, increased imageTimeout to 15s, forced reload of images with crossOrigin before capture, added onclone callback to ensure cloned images have crossOrigin set

implementedChanges.prompt: Improve PDF export timing and loading process
implementedChanges.implementation: Increased initial loading delay to 500ms, added 800ms delay after image reload for processing, increased image timeout to 8s, added 1s breathing room after all images load, increased capture delay to 600ms for better reliability

implementedChanges.prompt: Improve PDF transparency handling
implementedChanges.implementation: Added explicit opacity and visibility settings to cloned images, removed opacity from containers during clone, added windowWidth/windowHeight/scroll parameters for better rendering, ensured all images are fully opaque and visible in PDF capture

implementedChanges.prompt: Remove PDF export functionality
implementedChanges.implementation: Removed exportToPDF function, removed PDF export button, updated guide to remove PDF export instructions, simplified export section to focus only on shareable links

implementedChanges.prompt: Implement trait calculator UI foundation
implementedChanges.implementation: Added trait calculator state (calcSelectedUnit, unitSearchQuery, traitHistory), created two-column layout with unit selection on left and trait rolls on right, added searchable unit list with checkbox selection, added selected unit display box with CharacterCard, added Roll 1 section with Trait_Reroll.png icon, added trait history display box

implementedChanges.prompt: Make trait calculator much larger and fix image path
implementedChanges.implementation: Increased calculator to full screen height (h-screen), increased padding and spacing throughout, enlarged all text sizes (3xl headers, lg/xl text), made CharacterCard 1.5x scale, updated Trait_Reroll image path to use .webp from backgrounds folder, changed layout proportions to 1/3 left and 2/3 right, increased checkbox and icon sizes

implementedChanges.prompt: Implement trait rolling system with probabilities and colors
implementedChanges.implementation: Added traitProbabilities array with correct percentages (Vigor/Range/Swift 26%, Scholar 10%, Marksman 6.5%, Fortune 2.5%, Blitz 1.85%, Solar 0.5%, Deadeye 0.375%, Ethereal 0.175%, Monarch 0.1%), implemented rollTrait function with cumulative probability logic, added color coding (purple for Vigor, red for Range, blue for Swift, yellow for Scholar/Marksman/Fortune/Blitz, rainbow gradient for Solar/Deadeye/Ethereal/Monarch), updated trait history to display trait icons and colored text with timestamps, made roll button clickable with hover effect

implementedChanges.prompt: Make name text smaller, display current trait next to name, and change all UI colors to dark shades in trait calculator
implementedChanges.implementation: Reduced unit name text from text-xl to text-base, added currentTrait state to track last rolled trait, displayed current trait with icon and colored text next to unit name, changed all emerald UI colors to darker shades (emerald-300, emerald-800, emerald-900), updated glass-card backgrounds to slate-900 with higher opacity, darkened borders and hover effects

implementedChanges.prompt: Make name box much smaller, trait box bigger, add mythic celebration animation with confetti, and mythic trait toggles
implementedChanges.implementation: Made unit name input smaller (w-48, text-sm), enlarged trait display box with bigger icon (w-16) and text (text-3xl), added showMythicCelebration state and mythicTraitToggles state, created 10-second spinning animation (mythicSpin keyframe) that triggers on rainbow trait rolls, added confetti effect with 50 falling colored pieces, implemented mythic trait toggle UI with checkboxes for Solar/Deadeye/Ethereal/Monarch, updated rollTrait function to respect toggle state and recalculate probabilities, added glowing box-shadow effect during celebration

implementedChanges.prompt: Change mythic animation to only affect icon and only trigger for ultra-rare traits under 1%
implementedChanges.implementation: Modified rollTrait to only trigger celebration for traits with chance < 1% (Solar 0.5%, Deadeye 0.375%, Ethereal 0.175%, Monarch 0.1%), removed mythic-celebration class from trait box, created new mythic-icon-overlay with fixed positioning at screen center, replaced mythicSpin animation with mythicIconSpin that scales icon from 1x to 4x while spinning 1800 degrees over 10 seconds, added multi-colored drop-shadow effects (red, purple, green), icon fades in at start and out at end, confetti still triggers for all 4 ultra-rare traits

implementedChanges.prompt: Reduce animation to 3 seconds, add roll blocking, replace emerald with purple theme, create slick roll button
implementedChanges.implementation: Reduced mythic celebration from 10s to 3s, added isRolling state to prevent rolling during animation, changed all emerald colors to purple/violet/indigo throughout trait calculator (headers, borders, hovers, checkboxes, toggles), created new slick roll button with gradient background (purple-900 to indigo-900), added shimmer animation, button shows spinning icons and ROLLING text when active, button disabled when no unit selected or currently rolling, updated confetti timing to match 3s duration, changed trait calculator menu button and page header to purple theme

implementedChanges.prompt: Make mythic icon animation start from trait box, spin to center, then return
implementedChanges.implementation: Updated mythicIconSpin animation to start small (0.5 scale) from trait box position on right side, travel to center while growing and spinning (reaching 4.5x scale at center with 1800deg rotation), then return back to trait box while shrinking (back to 0.2 scale) and continuing to spin (total 3600deg = 10 full rotations), animation creates smooth circular path from trait box to center and back over 3 seconds

implementedChanges.prompt: Make icon spin to exact center and remove bounce effect
implementedChanges.implementation: Changed mythicIconSpin animation to travel to exact center of page (translate -50%, -50%) at 50% keyframe, removed elastic cubic-bezier easing and replaced with smooth ease-in-out for no bounce effect, increased total rotation to 4320deg (12 full spins), icon now smoothly grows from 0.5x to 4.5x at center then smoothly shrinks back to 0.2x

implementedChanges.prompt: Simplify animation to show icon in center with shine effect
implementedChanges.implementation: Completely redesigned mythicIconSpin animation to display icon directly in center of page, grows from scale 0 to 5.5x while spinning 3600deg (10 rotations), added animated shine effect with intensifying drop-shadow filters (red, purple, green glows increasing from 0 to 240px), peak shine at 70% keyframe then fades out, removed travel path animation, icon stays centered throughout

implementedChanges.prompt: Remove complex animation, just pop icon up with confetti
implementedChanges.implementation: Replaced mythicIconSpin with simple mythicIconPop animation, icon quickly pops in with slight bounce (scale 0 to 1.1 to 1), stays visible in center for most of 3 seconds, then pops out, no rotation or shine effects, increased icon size to 256px for better visibility, confetti effect remains active

implementedChanges.prompt: Make icon display in absolute center of screen using flexbox
implementedChanges.implementation: Changed mythic-icon-overlay from top/left positioning to flexbox centering (width 100vw, height 100vh with display flex, align-items center, justify-content center), removed translate transforms from animation keyframes since flexbox handles centering, icon now displays in exact mathematical center of viewport

implementedChanges.prompt: Move mythic icon overlay to root level for proper centering
implementedChanges.implementation: Moved mythic-icon-overlay from inside trait calculator container to root level of component (before closing div), this removes parent container constraints and allows flexbox to center icon properly relative to entire viewport instead of being positioned relative to nested container

implementedChanges.prompt: Add backdrop to icon overlay and implement tiered traits
implementedChanges.implementation: Added semi-transparent black backdrop (rgba 0,0,0,0.7) to mythic-icon-overlay to prevent background over-highlighting icon, implemented tiered variants for Vigor/Range/Swift with Roman numerals (50% chance I, 35% II, 15% III), updated all trait icon image sources to use split on space to extract base trait name for correct .webp file paths, tier level displays in trait name while using base icon

implementedChanges.prompt: Rename Trait Calculator to Trait Roller
implementedChanges.implementation: Changed all references from "Trait Calculator" to "Trait Roller" including menu button title, menu button description (Calculate to Roll), page header title, and page description, also changed icon from abacus emoji to dice emoji for better thematic match with rolling mechanic

implementedChanges.prompt: Move trait icon to top-right corner of unit card
implementedChanges.implementation: Repositioned trait icon from trait name box to top-right corner of unit card using absolute positioning, added relative positioning to CharacterCard wrapper, icon now displays at -top-2 -right-2 with z-10, added purple border and glow effects (border-2 border-purple-500, shadow-lg shadow-purple-500/50, drop-shadow filter), reduced icon size to w-12 h-12 for better proportion on unit card, trait name text remains in separate box

implementedChanges.prompt: Make trait icon display like familiar overlay on unit card
implementedChanges.implementation: Modified CharacterCard component to accept traitIcon prop, added trait icon overlay positioned at top-0 right-0 matching familiar overlay positioning, icon displays at w-8 h-8 size with rounded-bl-lg corner (mirrors familiar rounded-tl-lg), removed external wrapper and styling, trait icon now integrated directly into CharacterCard component at z-30 layer, added traitError state for error handling
